cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved putting the tent up before the rain. I'm quite familiar with these sleeves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I show you the clips? This tent doesn't have sleeves. The poles cross first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Demonstration granted. The clip system, naturally. I'll cross the poles; you may bring the fabric.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the outer cover. We're standing on the inner tent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The inner goes first, of course. You may step aside while I raise it. I always begin by laying everything out.
